title: Average Sale Price for Land Sold to Private Developers and HDB
what_it_is: Average Sale Price for Land Sold to Private Developers and HDB

sections.label: Land prices public private housing
sections.summary: Outside the Core Central Region, private housing land from Government Land Sales averaged about $7,000 psm from 2015 to 2018, while HDB paid about $2,000 psm for public housing land in mature estates.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: Excluding the Core Central Region, the average price of land paid for private housing developments bought through the Government Land Sales Programme between 2015 and 2018 was about $7,000 per square metre (psm).

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: In the same period, HDB paid an average of about $2,000 psm for land for public housing in mature estates.
